# Real `deal standard-history staple` output

`staple-card.json` and `staple-standard.json` are the unedited stdout of
`capsulectl deal standard-history staple --derivation history_card/1` and
`--derivation standard_history/1` from evidencebook-deal main daf15e9
(`stapleFixture` in `internal/deal/deal_standard_history_staple_test.go`: a person
who answers the card, one deal, one tick, test clock 2026-10-04T18:24Z). They pin the
shape `verify --history` reads as printed (capsule-cli#551). Test keys only.
